decisions.reason: As a line extension in a known sports-flooring domain, it likely stays unless results fall clearly below aspiration, and the firm's broad range gives enough slack to continue it while demand remains uncertain.
A mobile arena floor is a specialized and less strategically aligned niche, so if its early sales lag aspiration management is likely to reallocate resources to stronger core flooring lines.

Because this is another mobile arena system in a narrow segment, overlap and weak fit with the firm's style-led direction raise the chance that boundedly rational management drops it after disappointing feedback.
This chevron parquet is close to the core business and was presented as a flagship, so it is strongly protected by strategic fit and likely to be retained even if early results are still settling.

The squash surface finish is a small niche add-on, and if that niche underperforms relative to aspiration the firm has an obvious problemistic-search response of pulling back to broader flooring opportunities.
As a low-complexity accessory tied to existing sports floors, it is relatively cheap to carry and can be kept while the firm evaluates the wider sports-floor portfolio.
